summary: Join our Electrical Safety and Lockout/Tagout Training Course to empower your workforce. Learn vital safety protocols to protect employees and minimize risks.
lede: Electrical hazard control combines risk assessment, equipment isolation, and checks that confirm hazardous energy is controlled before work begins. This training is for people who plan, authorize, perform, supervise, or audit electrical and hazardous-energy work. Participants practice identifying hazards, designing equipment-specific lockout/tagout procedures, verifying the absence of voltage, coordinating group isolation, and documenting inspections and corrective actions.
audienceIntro: Electrical Safety and Lockout/Tagout Training is designed for professionals who plan, authorize, perform, supervise, or audit electrical and hazardous-energy work. It suits foundation to intermediate learners who need a structured operating method rather than a purely theoretical safety briefing.
modules: LOTO Audits, Training, and Compliance Evidence
Electrical Safety Performance and Action Planning
prerequisites: You should bring examples of non-confidential equipment procedures, isolation diagrams, permit forms, or audit checklists where available. A laptop is useful for digital templates and dashboard exercises, but no programming or specialist software installation is required. Practical activities use instructor-provided schematics, task scenarios, sample labels, lockout devices, and test-instrument demonstrations. Your organization should validate all procedures against applicable legal requirements, equipment manuals, electrical design information, and site-specific authorization rules.
